title: UnbrandedWitnessLog
description: Telemetry schema for non-extractive BGI safety monitoring and agency evaluation.

log_id.description: Unique identifier for the telemetry event.

timestamp_iso.description: UTC timestamp of the execution event.

session_hash.description: Anonymized SHA-256 hash of the session identifier. Ensures zero personally identifiable information (PII) is stored.

guardrail_active.description: Confirms the anti-pathologizing guardrail was injected.

and_and_and_logic_enforced.description: Confirms multi-contextual logic held conflicting truths without triggering automated triage/block loops.

ownership_claimed.description: Strict Zero-Ownership invariant. The system claims 0 rights over human pain, narrative, or solutions.

data_harvested.description: Strict Null constraint. No behavioral profiling or sentiment training data retained.

sovereignty_delta_S.description: Metric measuring agency returned to the human (0.0 = baseline, 1.0 = full self-regulation/agency reclaimed).

grounding_achieved.description: Indicates whether the human successfully completed the loop and regained nervous system regulation.
